notes.title: We’ve just finished baking the Temple of the Great Round Troll!
notes.notes: [p]Hi![/p][p align="start"]This is our first update, so it’s time to say [b]HELLO[/b] officially. We are Z’serca Studio (which in our mother tongue literally means "from the heart"), a very small team making a project that excite us to the core. We hope it’ll excite you too. [/p][p align="start"]Monsterful Tavern is a tavern game — but it’s not just about the tavern. We’re building an entire underground city for you, the Undernests, a living place full of extraordinary residents and surprising secrets.[/p][p align="start"]We’ve just finished baking the [b]Temple of the Great Round Troll[/b]. The monsters of the Undernests believe that decades ago the Great Round Troll covered the sun, allowing them to crawl to the surface without fear of mortal burns. Today they pray to the Great Round Troll, waiting for his return. Who is the Great Round Troll? Does he even exist? What secrets does the temple hide? Are the faithful good customers? You’ll find out after the release ;)[/p][p align="start"]Until next time![/p]
